profile.template: A headshot (front facing or profile - left or right) of a {family_name} ({animal_hint}), named {given_name}, who is {age} years old and {sex}. The image has the style and quality of a 70s polaroid. Plain neutral background. The image must be of an animal, but anthropomorphised (including age appropriate clothing, and various facial expressions) to show the personality and variety. Favour artistic expression over realism.

animal_hints.Kangaroo: marsupial with tall pointed ears, brown fur, and a long muzzle
animal_hints.Koala: round-faced grey marsupial with large fluffy ears and a wide black nose
animal_hints.Platypus: mammal with a flat duck-like bill, small dark eyes, and sleek brown fur
animal_hints.Wombat: broad flat face, small rounded ears, wide nose, and coarse brown fur
animal_hints.Wallaby: small marsupial with upright pointed ears, dark eyes, and a soft brown face
animal_hints.Tasmanian Devil: black-furred marsupial with rounded ears, pink inner ears, and a wide powerful jaw

animal_hints.Possum: large round dark eyes, pink nose, tall pointed ears, and grey-brown fur
animal_hints.Quokka: small round face with a permanent smile, dark eyes, and short rounded ears
animal_hints.Sugar Glider: huge dark round eyes, a pink nose, large membranous ears, and grey fur with a dark stripe
animal_hints.Kookaburra: stocky bird with a large heavy beak, dark eye-stripe, and brown-white plumage

animal_hints.Quoll: pointed face covered in white spots, large dark eyes, pink nose, and rounded ears
animal_hints.Bandicoot: long pointed snout, small rounded ears, and large dark eyes

animal_hints.Redback Spider: glossy black face with multiple small eyes and a red marking

animal_hints.Box Jellyfish: translucent dome-shaped bell with trailing tentacles
animal_hints.Cane Toad: wide warty face, bulging golden eyes, and a broad flat mouth
animal_hints.Green Tree Frog: smooth bright green face with enormous round golden eyes and a wide smile

animal_hints.Galah: pink-feathered face with a pale crest, grey wings, and a short curved beak

animal_hints.Goanna: long monitor lizard face with a forked tongue, scaly skin, and alert dark eyes
animal_hints.Lorikeet: rainbow-feathered parrot with a bright red beak, blue head, and green and yellow plumage
animal_hints.Magpie: black and white plumage, bright red-brown eyes, and a sharp pale beak
animal_hints.Brushtail Possum: large pointed ears, big dark eyes, a pink nose, and thick grey fur

animal_hints.Brush Turkey: bare bright red head, yellow wattle around the neck, and dark feathers

profile.negative_prompt: cartoon, drawing, illustration, text, watermark, blurry, deformed

radiology.template: A realistic {modality} medical imaging scan of the {body_region}, showing features consistent with {condition}. Clinical-quality radiographic image with proper contrast and exposure. No annotations or text overlays. SYNTHETIC TRAINING IMAGE.
radiology.negative_prompt: text, watermark, annotations, labels, arrows, cartoon, colorful, blurry

microscopy.template: A realistic microscopy image of a {specimen_type} sample, stained with {stain}, showing cellular features consistent with {condition}. High magnification, clinical pathology quality. No annotations or text overlays. SYNTHETIC TRAINING IMAGE.
microscopy.negative_prompt: text, watermark, annotations, labels, arrows, cartoon, blurry, low quality
